verses.text: A son [is] wise [by] the discipline of his father, and a mocker does not listen to rebuke.

segments.text: A son [is] wise [by] the discipline of his father, and a mocker does not listen to rebuke.

verses.text: From the fruit of the mouth a man eats good things, and the soul of the treacherous, violence.

segments.text: From the fruit of the mouth a man eats good things, and the soul of the treacherous, violence.

verses.text: One guarding his mouth is keeping his soul; one opening his lips, destruction [is] unto him.

segments.text: One guarding his mouth is keeping his soul; one opening his lips, destruction [is] unto him.

verses.text: The soul of a sluggish one is desiring, and [has] nothing; and the soul of the diligent ones is made fat.

segments.text: The soul of a sluggish one is desiring, and [has] nothing; and the soul of the diligent ones is made fat.

verses.text: A righteous one hates a word of falsehood, and a wicked one causes stench and shame.

segments.text: A righteous one hates a word of falsehood, and a wicked one causes stench and shame.

verses.text: Righteousness guards the one of integrity in the way, and wickedness overthrows the sinner.

segments.text: Righteousness guards the one of integrity in the way, and wickedness overthrows the sinner.

verses.text: There is one making himself rich and [having] nothing at all, one making himself poor and [having] abundant wealth.

segments.text: There is one making himself rich and [having] nothing at all, one making himself poor and [having] abundant wealth.

verses.text: His riches [are] the ransom for the soul of a man, and a poor one has not heard rebuke.

segments.text: His riches [are] the ransom for the soul of a man, and a poor one has not heard rebuke.

verses.text: The light of the righteous rejoices, and the lamp of the wicked is extinguished.

segments.text: The light of the righteous rejoices, and the lamp of the wicked is extinguished.

verses.text: Only with arrogance does one give forth strife, and wisdom [is] with the counseled ones.

segments.text: Only with arrogance does one give forth strife, and wisdom [is] with the counseled ones.

verses.text: Wealth from vanity is diminished, and the one gathering by the hand becomes great.

segments.text: Wealth from vanity is diminished, and the one gathering by the hand becomes great.

verses.text: Hope deferred weakens the heart, and desire fulfilled [is] a tree of life.

segments.text: Hope deferred weakens the heart, and desire fulfilled [is] a tree of life.

verses.text: The one despising the word is destroyed for it, and the one fearing the commandment, he will be rewarded.

segments.text: The one despising the word is destroyed for it, and the one fearing the commandment, he will be rewarded.

verses.text: The instruction of the wise [is] a fountain of life, to turn aside from the snares of death.

segments.text: The instruction of the wise [is] a fountain of life, to turn aside from the snares of death.

verses.text: Good insight gives favor, and the way of the treacherous [is] perpetual.

segments.text: Good insight gives favor, and the way of the treacherous [is] perpetual.

verses.text: Every prudent one acts with knowledge, and a fool spreads out folly.

segments.text: Every prudent one acts with knowledge, and a fool spreads out folly.

verses.text: A wicked messenger falls into evil, and an envoy of faithfulness [is] healing.

segments.text: A wicked messenger falls into evil, and an envoy of faithfulness [is] healing.

verses.text: Poverty and shame [are] to one disdaining discipline, and the one regarding a rebuke is honored.

segments.text: Poverty and shame [are] to one disdaining discipline, and the one regarding a rebuke is honored.

verses.text: A desire coming to pass is pleasant to the soul, and turning aside from evil [is] an abomination to fools.

segments.text: A desire coming to pass is pleasant to the soul, and turning aside from evil [is] an abomination to fools.

verses.text: The one walking with wise ones will become wise, and the one accompanying fools will suffer evil.

segments.text: The one walking with wise ones will become wise, and the one accompanying fools will suffer evil.

verses.text: Evil pursues the sinful ones, and goodness will reward the righteous ones.

segments.text: Evil pursues the sinful ones, and goodness will reward the righteous ones.

verses.text: A good one leaves an inheritance [for] the sons of his sons, and the wealth of the sinner is stored up for a righteous one.

segments.text: A good one leaves an inheritance [for] the sons of his sons, and the wealth of the sinner is stored up for a righteous one.

verses.text: There is much food [in] the fallow ground of the poor, and it is swept away for lack of justice.

segments.text: There is much food [in] the fallow ground of the poor, and it is swept away for lack of justice.

verses.text: The one withholding his rod is hating his son, and one loving him diligently seeks him with discipline.

segments.text: The one withholding his rod is hating his son, and one loving him diligently seeks him with discipline.

verses.text: A righteous one is eating to the satisfaction of his soul, and the belly of the wicked will be lacking.

segments.text: A righteous one is eating to the satisfaction of his soul, and the belly of the wicked will be lacking.
